senses: to obey one in authority, be obedient
lex:
πειθαρχέω, -ῶ
(πείθομαι, ἀρχή) [in LXX: Dan LXX 7:27 (שְׁמַע), Sir.33:28, I Est.8:94 * ;]
to obey one in authority, be obedient: Tit.3:1; with dative, Act.27:21; θεῷ, Act.5:29, 32.†

strongs.def: to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice
strongs.from: from a compound of G3982 (πείθω) and G757 (ἄρχω)
